text_block_list.text:
Once again, our murder mystery group
has
assembled to pin down the culprit
once and for
all. Now, the last we heard
was...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, actually, I was with Grass from just
after she
served dinner right up until we
all gathered here.
But while we were
together...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I caught a very brief glimpse of Sei
walking along
holding something...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Following Спешл Уик's revelation,
Сэйун Скай
seemed like the most likely
suspect. But in
response...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Spe's telling the truth. I was walking around the inn holding something.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Right. Last time, Sei admitted that Spe's

revelation was true. Tell us, Sei—do you
have
some sort of scheme up your
sleeve?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Nope, there's no scheming going on
here. I just
admitted the truth, that's all.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
More importantly, it all right if I go
ahead and
spill my secret now? It's a
pretty important one,
y'know.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
An important secret? Let's hear it!
Vamos!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So, I happened to get a look at Grass's
phone.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
And y'know what I saw? Plant-based
poison in her
purchase history.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Que fuerte! Poison?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That means Grass was the one who had
the
poison to begin with, and she spiked
the meal.
But she knew bringing
poisoned food directly
woulda been way
too obvious.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Luckily for her, King just happened to
leave the
room, and El had dropped by
right before that.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Grass figured she could frame El, so she
went
back to King's room and switched
the bowls...
How's that for a summary of
events?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Qué? So you're sayin' Grass is our main
suspect?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Huh? But Grass was...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Before I forget. That sound of

something breaking was King dropping
the bowl
after eating the poison.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
I happened to be nearby, so I rushed
over, and
that's when I found King.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I decided to run and tell
everyone, but
I figured it'd be
dangerous to leave the bowl on
the
floor, so I swept it up and took it with
me.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
That must be when Spe saw me booking
it with
the broken bowl. Nothing
suspicious after all,
right?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
So that's what you're going with, then?
But you
have no proof that what you're
saying is the truth,
correct?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Right, no evidence. Which means it's up
to all of
you to make up your minds one
way or another.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Сэйун Скай grins, and with two suspects
trying to
clear their name, a timer signals
the end of phase
two.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gahhh! Sei and Grass both seem muy

suspechosas!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I think back over everything that's been
revealed
so far. Who should I cast my
vote for?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the results in, Сэйун Скай receives
the most
votes and is deemed the
culprit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Darn it. Guess I couldn't pull the wool
over
anyone's eyes, huh?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
That's right, I'm the culprit. But this
whole thing
was just an unfortunate
series of events.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I'd actually cleaned King's room
during
the day, but I'd gone and left my
broom behind.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
I waited for King to leave her room so I
could
sneak in and grab it, but I
accidentally knocked it
over.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
It smashed the original bowl of
chawanmushi and
made a huge racket,
so I rushed to the kitchen for
a
replacement. I had no idea the food in
the blue
bowl had been poisoned.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Your story about my having gone
back to
the room to switch the bowls
was quite plausible
indeed.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And you timed the revelation that I had
been in
possession of the poison quite
effectively too.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
But things aren't always as they seem...

Ultimately, your explanation wasn't
consistent
with Spe's statement about
having been with me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's how you knew something
was up...
Guess I've gotta do better next
time.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, excellent. I would love to play
again.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The results are in, but the vote is
divided, so
Сэйун Скай is off the hook.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So the game ends without us knowing
who did it?
Maaan, what a bummer...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I mean, that's why they call it a murder mystery. The ambiguity's part of the suspense.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Everyone's lies were so convincing. We
should
definitely do this again sometime.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Qué?! I didn't tell any lies!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'd very much like to deduce the
identity of
the real liar next time.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: GASP!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Is it over?! It's finally over, right?! I
thought I'd
never be able to breathe
again...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh. Hey, King. Welcome back to the
world of the
living.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
With the results in, Грасс Вандер
receives the
most votes and is deemed
the culprit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Goodness me. Well...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, you've all been
deceived... by Sei's
lies.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Lying, bluffing, whatever you'd like to
call it. But I
am not the culprit.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Qué?! Really?! I have no idea what was
true and
what was a lie!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well, maybe Grass really isn't the
true
killer...
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
...But that doesn't necessarily mean
everything I
said was untrue. Fortune
favors the bold, am I
right?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm not sure precisely what you
mean, but
you do have a way with
words.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha! I suppose that's something
we have in
common.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Who was the real killer in the end?
Perhaps only
Сэйун Скай and Grass
Wonder know the truth...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Who was the real killer in the end?
Perhaps only
Сэйун Скай and Grass
Wonder know the truth...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And with that, the truth comes to light
and the
curtains close on the murder
mystery.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
